themes.name: Grid Infrastructure & Power Transmission
themes.thesis_summary: AI data centers require 10-100x more power than traditional facilities, creating massive bottleneck in grid infrastructure. Transformer shortages and grid upgrade needs create multi-year investment cycle in less crowded space.
key_catalysts: AI data center power demands creating grid strain
Utility capex increases for grid modernization

themes.name: Nuclear Energy Renaissance
themes.thesis_summary: Nuclear power experiencing renaissance driven by AI power demands and clean energy needs. Early stage of multi-decade cycle with strong policy support and tech company adoption.
key_catalysts: Major tech companies signing nuclear power deals
Uranium supply constraints with demand revival

themes.name: Defense Industrial Base Expansion
themes.thesis_summary: Defense spending surge driven by geopolitical tensions creating multi-year manufacturing capacity expansion cycle. Supply chain constraints favor established contractors with production capability.

themes.name: Energy Services & Infrastructure
themes.thesis_summary: Energy security focus driving domestic production and infrastructure investment. Services companies benefit from multi-year capex cycle with less commodity price sensitivity.

themes.name: Critical Materials & Mining
themes.thesis_summary: Critical materials bottleneck across multiple themes (AI, defense, energy) creating supply constraints. Reshoring initiatives provide multi-year demand visibility in under-owned sector.

themes.name: Regional Banks Recovery
themes.thesis_summary: Regional banks showing improving fundamentals as worst-case credit scenarios fail to materialize. Early stage recovery play in unloved sector with rate tailwinds.
